basic_details.job_title: DTU Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online for Professor, Assistant Professor Posts
basic_details.post_name: Assistant Professor of Practice (Training & Placement) and Professor of Practice (Training & Placement)

qualification.education_qualification: B.E./ B.Tech and MBA/ PGDM with first class from recognized University
qualification.details: Professor of Practice (Training & Placement): B.E/B.Tech and MBA/PGDM with first class from a recognized University; 15 years of industrial experience in recruitment/HR or as Officer/In-charge of Training & Placement at a degree-level institution (minimum 3 years at Level-13A equivalent). Assistant Professor of Practice (Training & Placement): B.E/B.Tech and MBA/PGDM with first class from a recognized University; 5 years of industrial experience in recruitment or as Officer/In-charge of Training & Placement at a degree-level institution (managerial level, pay not below Level-8).

selection_process: Screening Test (for Assistant Professor) Document & Points/Marks Verification Presentation Interview
how_to_apply: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the DTU Various Posts Recruitment 2026.
Applications must be submitted online on or before 07-09-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of DTU to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for DTU Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the DTU Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 07-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of DTU to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the DTU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the DTU Recruitment 2026 is 07 September 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before the deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies announced by DTU?
faq.answer: Delhi Technological University (DTU) has announced a total of 2 vacancies for the posts of Assistant Professor of Practice (Training & Placement) and Professor of Practice (Training & Placement).

faq.question: Q3. What are the educational qualifications required for these posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.E./B.Tech and MBA/PGDM with first-class marks from a recognized university to be eligible for these positions.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for the DTU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee varies by category. For General/OBC, it is Rs. 2000 for Assistant Professor and Rs. 3000 for Professor. For SC/ST, the fee is Rs. 1000, and for PwBD candidates, there is no fee.

faq.question: Q5. How will candidates be selected for the DTU posts?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a Screening Test (for Assistant Professor), Document & Points/Marks Verification, Presentation, and an Interview.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any industrial experience required for the Professor of Practice post?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates applying for the Professor of Practice post need to have 15 years of industrial experience in recruitment/HR or as an Officer/In-charge of Training & Placement at a degree-level institution.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application mode for DTU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode for DTU Recruitment 2026 is strictly online. Candidates need to visit the official website or use the provided link to submit their applications.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for these positions at DTU?
faq.answer: The positions of Assistant Professor of Practice and Professor of Practice at DTU are contractual in nature.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification for DTU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the "Important Links" section on this page. It is recommended to download and read it thoroughly before applying.
